from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class INA219_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x399F,  # CONFIGURATION
            0x01: 0x0000,  # SHUNT_VOLTAGE
            0x02: 0x0000,  # BUS_VOLTAGE
            0x03: 0x0000,  # POWER
            0x04: 0x0000,  # CURRENT
            0x05: 0x0000,  # CALIBRATION
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr:#04x}")
        
        value = self.regs[addr]
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        
        return value

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr:#04x}")
        
        if addr == 0x00:  # CONFIGURATION
            # RST bit is read-only and always reads as 0
            data &= ~(1 << 15)
        
        if addr == 0x05:  # CALIBRATION
            # FS0 bit is read-only and always 0
            data &= ~(1 << 0)
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            current_value = self.regs[addr]
            # Update only bits 15:8
            data <<= 8
            data |= (current_value & 0xFF)
        
        self.regs[addr] = data
